questions.q_en: Where is the headquarters of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research Institute located?
questions.solution_en: The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) is an autonomous organisation under the Department of Agricultural Research and Education (DARE), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare , Government of India. Formerly known as Imperial Council of Agricultural Research, it was established on 16 July 1929 as a registered society under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 in pursuance of the report of the Royal Commission on Agriculture. The ICAR has its headquarters at New Delhi.

questions.q_en: In which year did the first SAARC summit take place?
questions.solution_en: The first SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation) summit took place in 1985. The summit was held in Dhaka, Bangladesh, and it marked the beginning of collaborative efforts among the South Asian countries to promote regional cooperation and development.

questions.q_en:
The head office of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is located in ________.

Options:
questions.solution_en:
1) About the BCCI:

o The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is the governing body for cricket in India.

o It was established in 1928 and is affiliated with the International Cricket Council (ICC).

o The BCCI is responsible for organizing domestic and international cricket matches in India and manages the Indian Premier League (IPL).

2) Headquarters:

o The head office is located in Mumbai, at the Cricket Centre, Wankhede Stadium.

o Mumbai is considered the hub of Indian cricket, as it hosts several cricketing activities, historical venues, and major administrative offices.

3) Incorrect Options:

o Kolkata: While Eden Gardens, one of India's most iconic stadiums, is located here, the BCCI headquarters is not.

o New Delhi: Known for the Arun Jaitley Stadium but not linked to the BCCI headquarters.

o Chennai: The headquarters of the Tamil Nadu Cricket Association (TNCA) but not BCCI.

questions.q_en: The headquarters of the Indian Institute of Tourism and Travel Management are located at:
questions.solution_en:
The Indian Institute of Tourism and Travel Management (IITTM) is a premier institution under the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India. Its headquarters is located in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh.

Key Details:

· IITTM was established in 1983 to provide education and training in tourism, travel, and hospitality management.

· It has regional campuses in Bhubaneswar, Noida (near Delhi), Goa, and Nellore (Andhra Pradesh), but the main headquarters remains in Gwalior.
